hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -q 'ch-config-tool\.html$' && { echo 'ch-config-tool.html is BUILT from src/ — edit the source file instead (see the code map in CLAUDE.md for which one), then run: python3 tools/build.py. hooks.statusMessage: Rebuilding the tool and refreshing the code map
